title.zh: SK 海力士美国存托凭证认购踊跃，存储芯片股领涨
title.en: SK hynix U.S. ADR listing draws strong demand; memory stocks rise

summary.en: U.S. stock futures were mixed as memory-chip shares rose ahead of SK hynix’s U.S. ADR debut and Middle East tensions eased. Micron and AMD rose more than 5% as investors focused on AI demand and earnings.
summary.zh: 美股股指期货盘前涨跌互现。SK 海力士美国存托凭证（ADR）即将在纳斯达克挂牌，存储芯片板块走强，中东紧张局势也有所缓和。市场看好 AI 需求和企业业绩，美光与 AMD 涨逾 5%。

title.zh: 美伊新一轮空袭升级供应风险，WTI和布伦特原油触及日内高点
title.en: US-Iran Strikes Escalate Oil Supply Risks, WTI/Brent Hit Intraday Highs

summary.en: US-Iran geopolitical escalation drives oil higher and bonds lower, weighing on equity sentiment. Futures rose modestly as traders weigh both risk premiums from Middle East tensions against soft US June data.
summary.zh: 美国与伊朗的地缘政治紧张局势推动油价上涨，美债收益率上升。期货温和上扬，交易员在权衡中东紧张的避险溢价与美国 6 月疲软数据之间

title.zh: 美国宣布伊朗停火结束，因特朗普称中东紧张局势在军事行动后得到缓解
title.en: US declares Iran ceasefire over as Trump says Middle East tensions resolved after military strikes

summary.en: US stocks showed mixed-to-flat futures as Middle East tensions evolved with Trump declaring Iran ceasefire over. Oil prices surged >5% on WTI following US military strikes and Hormuz Strait vessel attacks, driving energy sector rally but pressuring inflation-sensitive growth names via higher yields. Fed minutes remained key focus while dollar held support at 101+. Asia markets declined overnight ahead of open.
summary.zh: 特朗普宣布对伊朗的停火结束之际，美股期货窄幅波动。美国对伊朗发动打击、霍尔木兹海峡船只遇袭后，WTI 原油上涨逾 5%，推动能源股反弹。美债收益率上行使对通胀和利率敏感的成长股承压。市场仍关注美联储会议纪要，美元指数维持在 101 上方，亚洲股市隔夜走弱。

title.zh: 半导体股遭重挫，尽管 Samsung 交出创纪录业绩但估值忧虑压倒利好消息
title.en: Semiconductor stocks slump despite Samsung's record earnings as valuation concerns dominate over profit news

summary.en: US markets extended losses from Friday following overnight weakness in Asia. Semiconductor stocks sold off despite Samsung's record quarter as investors priced-in high valuations and profit-taking amid DeepSeek chip competition concerns. Oil prices surged on renewed Middle East tensions after US strikes against Iran, while Treasury yields rose and the dollar strengthened to week-high levels.
summary.zh: 亚洲股市隔夜走弱后，美股延续跌势。尽管三星电子录得创纪录的季度业绩，半导体股仍遭抛售。投资者担忧估值过高，也在关注获利了结和 DeepSeek 相关的芯片竞争。美国对伊朗发动打击后，中东局势再度紧张，油价上涨。美债收益率上行，美元升至本周高点。

title.zh: 纳斯达克期货受科技股反弹提振走高，道指逼近记录水平
title.en: Nasdaq Futures Surge on Tech Rally, Dow Approaches Record Territory

summary.en: Wall Street futures climb ahead of services data, with Nasdaq futures moving higher as markets digest a strong week and position for Fed meeting minutes. Tech sector leads gains after holiday break while oil and precious metals ease from recent highs.
summary.zh: 美国服务业数据公布前，美股期货盘前走高，纳指期货领涨。市场在经历一周的强势行情后调整仓位，静待美联储会议决议纪要发布。科技板块假期休市后领涨，而原油和贵金属价格从近期高点回落。

title.zh: 就业报告不及预期：非农新增仅+5.7万低于预期的+11万，降息押注升温
title.en: Jobs Report Misses: Nonfarm Payrolls at +57K vs Expected +110K, Rate Cut Bets Rally

summary.en: US markets closed mixed with Dow at record highs as jobs data came in weak (+57K vs +110K expected), pushing investors to trim tech and AI chip exposure. Fed rate hike bets cooled significantly following the softer employment report, easing yield pressures across bonds and equities.
summary.zh: 美股收盘分化，道指创历史新高得益于非农数据偏弱（+57K 远低于预期的+110K），投资者减持科技和AI芯片敞口。较弱的就业报告显著缓解了市场对加息的押注，美债收益率压力减轻并向股市传导利好

title.zh: 美伊多哈和平谈判受阻；地缘政治风险溢价回归
title.en: US-Iran Doha Peace Talks Stall; Geopolitical Risk Premium Returns

summary.en: US futures soften into July as geopolitical tensions dim over US-Iran Doha peace talks, Fed rate hike fears mount with ~67% odds for September policy shift, and a strong Q2 rally draws profit-taking. Markets await ISM Manufacturing PMI (flash estimate at four-year high of 55.7) ahead today's formal release later midday.
summary.zh: 美股期货在七月伊始温和回调，美伊多哈和平谈判前景降温、美联储加息预期升温（9 月政策转向概率约 67%）以及二季度反弹获利回吐成为三大主线。市场关注今日正式发布的 ISM 制造业 PMI 初值（四年高点 55.7）。

title.zh: 道指收于 52,000 点上方，科技股继续推动风险偏好回升
title.en: Dow closes above 52,000 as tech powers another risk-on session

summary.en: U.S. futures are mixed to slightly firmer after Monday's strong close, with the Dow holding above 52,000 and mega-cap tech still doing most of the work. The overnight focus is the Iran/Hormuz risk premium: oil remains high enough to support energy, but not yet high enough to force a broad inflation shock.
summary.zh: 美股期货在周一强势收盘后呈现分化但略偏强，道指站稳 52,000 点上方，推动指数的仍然主要是大市值科技股。盘前最重要的变量是伊朗与霍尔木兹海峡带来的地缘风险溢价：油价足以支撑能源板块，但还没有高到足以引发全面通胀冲击。

title.zh: 美股期货因和平谈判希望而上涨；油价维持地缘溢价
title.en: US Stock Futures Rise on Peace Talks Hope; Oil Holds Geopolitical Premium

summary.en: U.S. equity futures edge higher as investors weigh the evolving US-Iran geopolitical standoff for signs of sustained deescalation rather than fresh escalation, with oil trading near $73 driven by Strait of Hormuz concerns but still below inflation-risk thresholds.
summary.zh: 美股期货小幅走强，投资者关注美伊局势演变是否预示可持续降级而非新一轮升级，油价徘徊在 73 美元附近受霍尔木兹海峡担忧支撑但仍未达通胀警戒线。

title.zh: 美国对伊朗发动第二轮打击，OPEC+ 收紧产量削减
title.en: US Launches Second Wave of Strikes on Iran, OPEC+ Tightens Production Cuts

summary.en: US-Iran geopolitical tensions escalate as a second wave of military strikes near the Strait of Hormuz rattles energy markets and lifts oil prices. Equity futures slip ahead of U.S. market open amid concerns about supply disruptions in key shipping lanes and inflation implications from higher crude costs.
summary.zh: 美国与伊朗地缘政治紧张局势升级，第二波针对霍尔木兹海峡附近的军事打击扰乱能源市场并推高油价。美股盘前指数下跌，担忧关键航运通道的供应中断和原油成本上升的通胀影响。

title.zh: 美国确认对伊朗实施报复性打击，盘后推升油价
title.en: U.S. confirms retaliatory strike on Iran, pulling oil prices higher after hours

summary.en: The tape is event-driven into the weekend: U.S. retaliatory action on Iran has revived a fresh oil-risk premium, while Nasdaq futures lag and gold stays bid. The broad market is still only mildly softer, so this is more of a rotation shock than a full risk-off break for now.
summary.zh: 周末前的主线是典型的事件驱动：美国对伊朗的报复性行动重新抬升了原油风险溢价，纳指期货继续跑输，而黄金保持强势。整体市场只是小幅走弱，因此当前更像是风格轮动冲击，而不是全面的风险出清。

title.zh: 美光盘后暴涨16%，点燃科技股反弹，市场关注今晚 PCE 通胀数据
title.en: Micron (MU) earnings surge +16% after-hours sparks tech rally ahead of PCE data

summary.en: Micron's surprise earnings surge reignited the AI trade, with Nasdaq futures jumping ~2% ahead of today's PCE inflation data. Oil markets ignored IRGC threats as WTI tested pre-conflict levels near $78/Bbl while gold fell below $4K amid disinflationary signals.
summary.zh: 美光（MU）意外强劲的财报引发 AI 板块反弹，纳指期货上涨约 2%，今日 PCE 通胀数据公布前市场情绪回暖。油价无视 IRGC 威胁而维持在战前水平附近$78/Bbl，黄金在去通胀信号下跌破$4K。

title.zh: 早盘科技抛售缓和：油价缓解抵消了 AI 估值忧虑
title.en: Tech Selloff Eases in Early Session: AI Valuation Jitters Offset by Oil Price Relief

summary.en: Markets edge higher in early trading with S&P +0.6%, Nasdaq +0.7% despite lingering AI valuation concerns and chip sector weakness from Korean peers (-10%). Oil continues selloff below $72 amid Iran peace progress, while gold tests support at $4,000 as strong dollar and Fed rate hike bets weigh on precious metals.
summary.zh: 市场在早盘小幅上涨，标普指数 +0.6%，纳指 +0.7%，尽管 AI 估值担忧和对韩国芯片股疲弱的持续影响（-10%）。油价在地缘政治缓和背景下继续下跌至 $72 以下，黄金因美元走强和美联储加息赌注而测试$4,000支撑位。

title.zh: AI 抛售加深：韩国芯片股暴跌 10%，Mag-7 主导风险轮动
title.en: AI Selloff Deepens: Korean Chipmakers Plummet 10% as Mag-7 Dominates Risk Rotation

summary.en: Dow futures plunge about 1% as AI megacap selloff spreads to Asian chipmakers (Korea -10%), with Nasdaq futures down nearly 3%. Treasury yields climb on rate hike bets while oil prices fall despite US-Iran peace hopes. SpaceX (+ve post-earnings) bucks broader tech trend amid Mag-7 concerns.
summary.zh: 道指期货暴跌约 1%，AI 龙头抛售蔓延至亚洲芯片股（韩国 -10%），纳指期指跌幅近 3%。美债收益率因加息赌注而上升，油价在美伊和平希望下下跌。SpaceX(财报后反弹)逆势上涨，Mag-7担忧加剧市场波动。

title.zh: SpaceX 暴跌 16%，华尔街消化 Mag-7 板块抛售，抵消中东和平希望
title.en: SpaceX Tumbles 16% as Wall Street Digests Mag-7 Selloff, Offsetting Middle East Peace Hopes

summary.en: US futures slip on mixed geopolitical signals from US-Iran peace talks, AI sector volatility led by SpaceX sell-off (-16%), and lingering high yield pressure. Market sentiment remains bifurcated between risk-on trade driven by potential Middle East de-escalation and tech-sector concerns amid Mag-7 selloff.
summary.zh: 美股期指因美伊和平谈判带来混杂的地缘政治信号而下跌，AI 板块受 SpaceX(-16%)抛售影响波动加大，高收益率压力犹存。市场情绪呈现分化：中东局势缓和带来的风险偏好与科技股 (Mag-7)抛售引发的担忧并存。

title.zh: 美盘前期货受 Juneteenth 假期和 US-伊朗协议预期影响回落
title.en: US Futures Retreat as Juneteenth Holiday and US-Iran Deal Loom

summary.en: US futures retreated on Juneteenth ahead of the US-Iran nuclear agreement milestone, while economic data (ADP +122K jobs, ISM Services PMI at 54.5) reinforces Fed's higher-for-longer stance amid surging oil prices ($96 WTI, $97 Brent). Chip stocks rallied on improved geopolitical sentiment and TSMC/Nvidia strength.
summary.zh: 美盘前受 Juneteenth 假期和 US-伊朗核协议里程碑影响，美股期货回落。强劲的经济数据（ADP 私营部门新增 12.2 万个岗位、ISM 服务业 PMI54.5）与飙升的油价支撑美联储维持高利率立场。芯片股在地缘政治缓和及 TSMC/Nvidia 走强带动下上涨。

title.zh: 美伊和平乐观情绪消退后美股期货回落
title.en: US Stock Futures Retreat After Iran Peace Optimism Fades

summary.en: US futures retreat as geopolitical optimism fades; U.S.-Iran MOU faces implementation skepticism with VP Vance's Switzerland trip cancelled. Tech stocks lead morning losses amid tech-led Friday rally reversal. Oil prices stabilize after Hormuz reopening, but USD strength pressures gold/silver to multi-week lows.
summary.zh: 美股期货因地缘政治乐观情绪消退而回落；美伊备忘录实施引发质疑，副总统万斯取消瑞士访问。科技股领跌早盘市场，逆转此前由科技股带动的反弹。油价在霍尔木兹重开后企稳，但美元走强打压金/银跌至数周低位。

title.zh: 美联储主席 Warsh 首次会议：鹰派暂停还是鸽派转向即将揭晓
title.en: Fed Chair Warsh's First Meeting: Hawkish Pause or Dovish Pivot Looms

summary.en: Premarket focus centers on Fed Chair Warsh's first policy announcement amid easing geopolitical tensions from US-Iran peace accord progress. Oil prices decline below $80/barrel on supply normalization expectations, while tech-led Nasdaq futures rise +0.71% with AI/semiconductor stocks rebounding post-Friday losses.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点集中在美联储主席 Warsh 的首次政策声明，同时美伊和平协议进展缓解地缘紧张局势。油价因供应正常化预期跌破$80/桶，科技股主导的纳斯达克期货上涨 0.71%，AI 和半导体股票在周五跌幅后出现反弹。
